sam: FYI onboarding magnum-14b-int4fp ran into output drift after long prefill (≈12k tokens). seems to start diverging near token 12288, reproducible locally.
jordan: can you paste the exact command and a tiny log snippet?
sam: repro command i used:\n```
PYTHONPATH=. python -m evals.kv_longprefill --model magnum-14b-int4fp --prefill 12000 --seed 7 --no-stream
```\nlog excerpt:\n```
[2026-03-05 09:12:01] prefill_len=12000
[2026-03-05 09:12:01] kv_window=16384 shard=1
[2026-03-05 09:12:44] token=12287 logits match
[2026-03-05 09:12:44] token=12288 KL=1.87 divergence
```
priya: 12288 is suspicious (3/4 of 16384). converter metadata attached to the artifact shows `rope_scale: 0.70710678` (1/sqrt(2)). runtime default is 1.0. converter might be applying an older normalization during export.
max: also note: int4 packer v2 had a small rounding clip on layernorm bias during quantize_pack if seq_len > 10k — saw this in a separate audit. could amplify the rotatory mismatch.
jordan: plan: A) force runtime per-model env ROPE_SCALE to 0.7071 and rerun; B) convert to fp16 (no int4) to isolate quant effects; C) run int4 with new packer flags `--preserve-sign-bits`.
infra-bot: test job queued: kv-longprefill/magnum-14b-int4fp/3219876543 :gear:
sam: quick results from A (env override):\n```
-- token 12288: baseline vs override KL=0.03
-- override matches fp16-run output distribution
```
jordan: B (fp16) still diverged when runtime used ROPE_SCALE=1.0 -> implies converter-exported rope scaling is the primary cause.
max: with `--preserve-sign-bits` int4 run reduced KL at boundary from 1.87 -> 0.45, so quantization also contributes but is not sole cause.
priya: immediate mitigation: allow model-config `rope_scale` to be honored by runtime (per-model override) and update model catalog metadata. conversion fix is next: embed `rope_scale` in model-index.json and add a converter flag `--no-legacy-rope` to avoid accidental rescaling.
jordan: i'll open PRs: runtime override (#1429) + converter metadata (#1430). will add an assert on model-load if `rope_scale` present to warn on mismatch.
infra-bot: CI run started for PR 1429/1430.
sam: created ticket ML-4521 (long-prefill gate check + quant packer audit). pinned reproduce steps and artifacts: s3://redwood-ci/magnum-14b-int4fp/3219876543/trace.tar.gz
max: follow-ups: 1) ship runtime override behind a feature flag; 2) audit other converters for exported rope_scale values; 3) add long-prefill smoke to onboarding checklist (>10k tokens). tagging @product @oncall.
priya: thanks — putting the mitigation and notes in the model catalog entry so customers get a hint when selecting magnum-14b-int4fp. :white_check_mark:
infra-bot: test job complete: some failures unrelated to rope_scale (infra flaky), but rope-scale experiments passed. artifacts: s3://redwood-ci/magnum-14b-int4fp/3219876543/report.html :rocket:
